I was playing Fruit Ninja IRL while in my pool. So the fruit was bobbing in the water and I pulled the knife through the water to cut the fruit. I do a couple swings and got it. I have a faint one between my eyebrows from when I was knocked unconscious by a swing in a park. When I was about 13, the city park in the little town where I grew up installed some new-fangled playground equipment, including this one really ill-advised swing that rotated around in a circle and lifted the riders through centrifugal force1. One day, as I was walking past the swing, someone on the other side swung one of the seats really hard, causing its counterpart to loop around and hit me in the face. The seats were these heavy hard-rubber things. I don't remember the actual hit, just getting up and noticing that one of the lenses on my glasses was filled with blood.

It's a vertical scar about 1/2 inch long. Not really visible any more due to frown lines, but I know it's there.

1 - yes I am aware this is not a real thing, but it's easier than saying "The reaction force to the centripetal force."

How many. I have 3 if I include the several on my eyebrows as one.

Biggest and oldest one: I used to BMX race as a child. I was practicing with my brother doing sprints in a friends neighborhood. His friend was the fastest kid we knew. Him and my brother were nationally ranked 3 and 5 respectively in their age group. Amazing racers. His friend, let's call him James, used to do this thing where every time he pedalled he moved the bike with the pedal motions....not sure how to describe it. My father always told me not to do that, that it may look cool, but it could be dangerous. So I go up to do my sprint. James is the one timing me. I wanted to look cool. He was kind of cute and I wanted to impress him. To do this I tried to mimic the way he rode his bike......well I came out going faster than ever. I was so excited. Then, I hit a peice of loose asphalt and flew off of my bike.....I had road rash all the way from mid thigh to my waist. I was about 9 years old then. Now, I'm 22. The area where I slid across the asphalt is still pink.

Eyebrow ones are from fainting. I have Vaso Vagal Syncope responses with seizure activity. My brow area has quite a few scars from falling.

The other is on my foot. When I was little I was outside alone in the yard. We had sand all in the driveway. I thought it would feel really cool to run barefoot through the sand. There was a piece of glass. I slashed my foot on it pretty badly. It's hard to explain.....but where I cut my foot I have a huge gouge that looks to be an extremely thick line, like the ones already on your feet. Super weird.

Do I like them? The foot one kind of. Idk why. It just kind of looks cool. The others? Absolutely no way. Idk the BMX one is just really embarrassing.
